prompt:
Close-up editorial photograph of a beauty professional's hands in blush-pink nitrile gloves arranging plain, unbranded lash-lift tools on a warm cream travertine tray: simple stainless steel tweezers, a slim lift rod, a few translucent silicone shields. Soft window light from the upper right, shallow depth of field, calm and precise. Cropped at the wrists.

House style: Warm, calm, precise; an atelier for lash and brow professionals. Cream, blush and dusty rose; soft window light from the upper right; natural stone and satin; generous negative space. Editorial beauty still life, never glossy advertising, never clinical.

Do not include: faces, eyes, lashes being treated, a client, brand names, text, logos, packaging, bottles, tubes, jars, jewellery, long nails, messy surface. Never: products, bottles, tubes, jars, boxes, packaging or labels; text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or brand marks; faces, eyes, lashes or brows; before-and-after or treatment results; a recognisable person; stock clichés: flowers scattered on marble, fanned makeup brushes, spa stones, candles, champagne, gold glitter.

Photographic, natural, no illustration look, no AI gloss, no watermark.

review.why: Calm, precise and on-palette: blush nitrile gloves, plain tools and silicone shields on a travertine tray in window light; no face, text, logo or packaging (vision gate agrees). Shown in the courses section with the label תמונת אווירה.
